My wife and I are learning sign language with our baby. He isn’t deaf, but he doesn’t have all of his phonics and words, yet. He understands more than he can speak, and being able to use his hands to clarify what he wants is saving a lot of crying and fussing. For example, he doesn’t say his R’s yet. So when he is saying “ma” on repeat, we ask if he wants mommy, or more. “Num” on repeat, we ask if he wants food, or no more. He clarifies with his hands, we do what he told us, and it eliminates a lot of guessing which makes fussing stop faster or prevents it from beginning in the first place. For the last few weeks, he will use some signs while he is babbling, and we will repeat the sign while saying the word. He gets so excited, and it has made learning to speak more fun and engaging for him. He’s only 17 months old.
